title: Microsoft launches seven in-house MAI models, led by MAI-Code-1-Flash for GitHub Copilot
summary: Microsoft AI unveils a family of seven first-party MAI models (image, voice, transcription, thinking, coding) at Build 2026, with MAI-Code-1-Flash (5B params) rolling out as a default model in VS Code GitHub Copilot and MAI-Voice-2 now supporting 10+ extra languages.

title: GitHub launches the Copilot app, a native agentic desktop for developers
summary: GitHub unveils the new GitHub Copilot app in technical preview, a native desktop 'My Work' view that orchestrates parallel agent sessions across repos with sandboxed cloud/local execution, the GA GitHub Copilot SDK in Node, Python, Go, .NET, Rust, and Java, and Memory++ for cross-device continuity.

title: Alibaba's Qwen team ships Qwen3.7-Plus, a multimodal agent model on Bailian
summary: Alibaba releases Qwen3.7-Plus, a multimodal model that unifies vision and language into a single agent foundation, on the Bailian (Model Studio) platform. Its preview ranks #16 in LM Arena vision, with deep reasoning, self-programming, tool invocation, and Agentic RL feedback built into the platform.

title: Perplexity Computer adds real-time local-cloud task splitting, demoed at Computex
summary: Perplexity unveils hybrid agentic inference for Perplexity Computer, deciding in real time which subtasks stay on a local model and which get routed to frontier cloud models, with chip-agnostic support. The feature is rolling out in July, alongside a new Search as Code architecture for Computer and Agent API.

title: Microsoft Build 2026 spotlights in-house coding model and Windows Agent Runtime
summary: Microsoft Build 2026 in San Francisco leads with a first-party coding model for GitHub Copilot, the production Microsoft Agent Framework, and a Windows Agent Runtime preview.

title: NVIDIA unveils Vera, the first CPU purpose-built for AI agents
summary: NVIDIA launches Vera, a new 88-core CPU for the Vera Rubin platform with 1.8x the task-completion speed of x86, claiming Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, ByteDance, CoreWeave and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure as adopters. Vera powers standalone servers, Vera Rubin systems, and the Vera BlueField-4 STX AI storage processor.

title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin ramps into full production for agentic AI factories
summary: NVIDIA's third-generation MGX platform Vera Rubin begins full production with 150+ Taiwan supply chain partners, delivering 10x agent throughput vs. Grace Blackwell.

title: NVIDIA unveils Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B open MoE for long-running agents
summary: NVIDIA launches Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550B-parameter mixture-of-experts open model for always-on agents, claiming 5x faster inference and 30% lower cost.

title: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 launches as open frontier foundation model for physical AI
summary: NVIDIA's Cosmos 3 is the first fully open omnimodel that natively reasons and generates text, images, video, ambient sound and action for physical AI development.

title: NVIDIA RTX Spark superchip brings 1-petaflop personal AI to Windows PCs
summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft unveil RTX Spark, the first Windows PC purpose-built for personal AI agents with 1 petaflop performance and NVIDIA OpenShell runtime.

title: NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super brings open 32B reasoning VLA to level-4 robotaxis
summary: NVIDIA launches Alpamayo 2 Super, an open 32-billion-parameter reasoning vision-language-action model for safer level-4 autonomous vehicle development.

title: MiniMax M3 debuts with 1M context, native multimodality and open-weights commitment
summary: MiniMax releases M3, the first open-weight model combining frontier coding performance, 1M-token MSA context window, and native image/video input at 1/20th the compute of M2.

title: Mistral releases Voxtral open-source speech models with 32K context at $0.001/minute
summary: Mistral ships Voxtral Small (24B) and Mini (3B) under Apache 2.0, supporting 30-40 minutes of audio with 32K context. Voxtral Mini Transcribe undercuts OpenAI Whisper at $0.001/minute via API and on Hugging Face, with voice mode integration in Le Chat coming in the weeks ahead.

title: OpenAI upgrades GPT-5.5 Instant with better readability, retires GPT-4.5 and o3
summary: OpenAI ships an updated GPT-5.5 Instant with a more natural tone and fewer bullet-heavy responses, while scheduling GPT-4.5 sunset for June 27 and o3 for August 26.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 4.8 with stronger agentic coding and effort controls
summary: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 4.8, the latest Claude Opus flagship with improved coding and reasoning, a new effort control for users, and dynamic workflows in Claude Code.

title: Anthropic introduces dynamic workflows in Claude Code for end-to-end coding
summary: Claude Code gets dynamic workflows that orchestrate hundreds of parallel subagents to complete codebase-scale migrations with built-in verification.

title: xAI ships Grok Build 0.1 coding model on API alongside Composer 2.5 in CLI
summary: xAI makes grok-build-0.1, the agentic coding model powering the Grok Build CLI, available via the xAI API in public beta at a 256K context window.

title: Alibaba Cloud launches Qwen Cloud for global markets, built for AI agents
summary: Alibaba Cloud debuts Qwen Cloud, an AI-native platform with Skills for agents, a CLI, and unified access to Qwen, open-source and third-party multimodal models.

title: Mistral debuts Vibe agent and Mistral for Industrial Engineering at AI Now Summit
summary: Mistral consolidates Le Chat into the Vibe unified agent platform, launches Mistral for Industrial Engineering with Airbus, BMW, EDF and CMA CGM, and announces a Les Ulis data center.

title: Perplexity Computer lands inside Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
summary: Perplexity's multi-model Computer agent is now available as add-ins across Microsoft 365 apps, orchestrating 19+ models to draft documents, build sheets and rewrite emails.

title: Apple plans to make on-device AI a key WWDC 2026 focus, leaning on custom silicon
summary: Apple will highlight on-device Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2026 (June 8), using a distilled version of Google's Gemini to run locally and Nvidia confidential compute in the cloud.

title: Amazon plans to bring SpaceXAI's Grok models to Amazon Bedrock
summary: AWS is in talks to add SpaceXAI's Grok to Bedrock alongside Anthropic, Meta, Cohere and OpenAI, deepening SpaceXAI's enterprise reach ahead of its SpaceX IPO.

title: DeepSeek permanently cuts V4 Pro pricing by 75%, locking in the agent-era cost play
summary: DeepSeek makes its 75% V4 Pro discount permanent, dropping V4 Pro to $0.003625-$0.87 per million tokens to position itself as the cost-effective default for AI agents.

title: Mistral ships Medium 3.5 open-weight flagship with Work mode in Le Chat
summary: Mistral releases Medium 3.5, a 128B dense open-weight model merging instruction-following, reasoning and coding, and ships Work mode in Le Chat plus remote Vibe agents.
